text: Just got back from the beach. The bag tore .... Just got back from the beach. The bag tore quickly . It’s difficult to get back into the carrying case. Never did use the leg part . A little too much work !

product_metadata.title: Sport-Brella Beach Chair with UPF 50+ Adjustable Umbrella
features: Enjoy long hours of leisure with this low-profile beach chair with optional umbrella attachment, padded armrests and cupholder.No Assembly required
Water resistant material and large mesh panel ideal for water and beach activity; included sun umbrella with UPF 50 plus shade coverage
Padded, durable arm rests in dark matte color for heat protection; attached collapsible cup holder
Sturdy steel frame with wide seat design that supports up to 242 lbs.
Easy fold up design with included drawstring carry bag; dimensions 5.9 X 5.9 X 36.5 X 7.65, weighs 7.65lbs
